g.text: diff2: single-qubit gates in the transition (SWITCH) round, noiseless CZ-basis circuits, d=3.
Squares = ancillas, circles = data. Gates drawn as filled markers.
The five CZ moments (2, 5, 8, 6, 6 CZ, ticks 22 to 29) are the same in all three.
